Game Overview

In Draw to Pee Toilet Race!, the core idea is straightforward: guide quirky characters to the toilet in time by drawing paths through increasingly complex levels. Exercise strategic thinking to prevent collisions, testing your problem-solving skills in this imaginative challenge. With each level offering unique puzzles, your creativity will be the key to victory.

Draw to Pee Toilet Race! keeps its controls loop simple so the focus stays on the challenge. Guide quirky characters to the toilet in time by drawing paths through increasingly complex levels.
